import requests, re, os, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
def fa(a):
    r=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60,headers=H)
    return "".join(r.text.strip().split("\n")[1:])

# ---------------- Isoform / paralog topology decision table (all values computed in this session) -------------
iso=pd.DataFrame([
 ["GLIPR1L2","Q4G1C9-1",344,"NO","1","255-274","o...i","complete (58-192)","single-pass, CAP lumenal, 70-aa acidic cytoplasmic tail"],
 ["GLIPR1L2","Q4G1C9-2",253,"NO","0","-","i (soluble)","complete","no anchor and no SP: predicted cytosolic, NOT secreted"],
 ["GLIPR1L2","Q4G1C9-3",106,"NO","0","-","i (soluble)","truncated","CAP domain disrupted; not a secreted CAP protein"],
 ["GLIPR1L2","Q4G1C9-4",168,"NO","0","-","i (soluble)","truncated","CAP domain disrupted; not a secreted CAP protein"],
 ["GLIPR1L2","Q4G1C9-5",237,"NO","1","148-167","o...i","N-terminally truncated (lacks 1-107)","anchor kept, targeting region lost: tail-anchored-like"],
 ["GLIPR1L2","Q4G1C9-6",279,"NO","1","190-209","o...i","N-terminally truncated (lacks 1-77)","anchor kept, targeting region lost: tail-anchored-like"],
 ["GLIPR1","P48060-1",266,"YES (c21/22)","1","236-255","o...i","complete (38-175)","canonical single-pass type I, 11-aa cytoplasmic tail"],
 ["GLIPR1","P48060-2",237,"YES (c21/22)","0","-","SP only","complete","predicted secreted"],

# ---------------- Final summary figure ----------------
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,4.2))
def draw(y,total,sp,tm,cap,label,spcol="#38a169"):
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0,y),total,0.52,fc="#edf2f7",ec="#4a5568",lw=.8))
    if cap: ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((cap[0],y),cap[1]-cap[0],0.52,fc="#a0aec0",ec="none"))
    if sp:  ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((sp[0],y),sp[1]-sp[0],0.52,fc=spcol,ec="none"))
    if tm:  ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((tm[0],y),tm[1]-tm[0],0.52,fc="#e53e3e",ec="none"))
    ax.text(-8,y+0.26,label,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=8.5)

ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0,4.0),22,0.52,fc="#fc8181",ec="none"))
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((22,4.0),20,0.52,fc="#f6ad55",ec="none"))

ax.text(232,0.15,"GPI",fontsize=7,ha="center",color="#553c9a")
ax.set_xlim(-95,380); ax.set_ylim(0,5.1); ax.axis("off")
import matplotlib.patches as mp
leg=[mp.Patch(fc=c,label=l) for c,l in [("#fc8181","conserved N-terminal extension (pLDDT 47)"),
     ("#f6ad55","cryptic signal peptide, not predicted in full-length"),("#38a169","predicted signal peptide"),
     ("#a0aec0","CAP/SCP domain"),("#e53e3e","transmembrane helix"),("#d6bcfa","acidic cytoplasmic tail (net -24)"),
     ("#805ad5","GPI signal")]]

             fontsize=10.5,pad=26)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# save computed provenance tables
out="/agent/jobs/2d656fd2-6dfe-4ffa-8ea9-27d14d7b38c6/provenance"

    iso.to_csv(f"{out}/GLIPR1L2_isoform_topology_table.csv",index=False)
